text: [shouting] SEVENTEEN! [excited] times a day... do you know what this word means?
[shouting] SEVENTEEN! [normal] times a day... do you know what this word... [shouting] MEANS?
[shouting] SEVENTEEN! [curious] times a day... do you know what this word means?
In every rakah of al-Fatiha, you say:
Master... of the Day... of what?
You know deen as religion. But here, what does it mean?
Repayment. The Day everyone is repaid for what they did. That's why we call it the Day of Judgement.
Seventeen times a day is over six thousand times a year. Now you'll know what you're saying.
Did you know this one? Comment yes or no below, and send this to someone you pray with.
